summary: Iteration 9: tested auto-translation (pt/fr/en/es on Profile + Landing switchers, Home/Profile/Jobs/Chat/Housing/Map/Volunteers, placeholders, dialogs, user posts, toasts, restore to pt), post video upload/streaming (real in-browser webm uploaded via UI, played back readyState=4, Range 206/416), emoji pickers (title, description, comment), profile photos (multi upload, viewer, remove, max 6, owner-only delete, validation), Jobs scroll (only on Buscar Vagas, not on load/category chip; jobs API mocked via page.route), admin email logic (code review only) and regression of appointments + password reset (pytest). All core flows pass; no page errors/crashes while translated. Language left at pt.

minor.issue: Unauthenticated and un-rate-limited: anyone can drive LLM (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) cost with 150 x 3000-char texts per request.
LLM output cached forever with no invalidation; e.g. 'Buscar Vagas de emprego' -> es returned unchanged (LLM judged it Spanish) and is now permanently cached untranslated.
Non-range requests read the whole file (up to 50MB) into memory; upload also buffers the full file. Consider StreamingResponse / chunked GridFS read.

integration_issues.issue: On uncached pages (e.g. /map with 64 services) translation takes ~8-12s because AutoTranslate sends one in-flight batch of 120 texts at a time and also translates addresses/opening hours. Works, just slow on first visit.

issues: Close (X) button has low contrast over the photo (transparent dialog)
Photos are only visible on own Profile; GET /api/users/{id}/photos exists but no UI shows other users' photos (e.g. volunteer/user profile)

action_items: Protect /api/translate (require auth or rate-limit per IP) to avoid LLM cost abuse
Optional: do not cache translations identical to the source (or add TTL) so LLM misses can be retried
Optional: stream video responses instead of loading full file in memory
Optional: improve close-button contrast in profile photo viewer; consider showing profile photos on public user profiles
critical_code_review_comments: is_admin_email + register/login promotion logic is correct (case-insensitive, trims, persists role on login). Not live-tested by editing ADMIN_EMAILS (avoided touching backend/.env); mecjohnson97@gmail.com was NOT registered.
profile_photos collection has no index on user_id (count/find per request)
server.py is ~2560 lines - should be split into routers
CreatePostDialog: if video upload fails the post stays published without video (only a toast) - acceptable but no retry
seed_data_creation: None persisted. TEST_ posts/videos/photos created during tests were cleaned up (also removed 1 orphan GridFS chunk).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via page.request to /api/auth/login and set localStorage token/user/lang ('pt'|'fr'|'en'|'es'). Translation cache: Mongo 'translations' + localStorage tr_cache_<lang>. Real webm can be generated in-browser via canvas.captureStream + MediaRecorder and set_input_files on create-post-video-input. Comment emoji requires clicking post-comments-toggle-<id> first. Only 1 seeded post ('Teste video 🎉' by Ana) exists in feed.
